AN ABSOLUTE READING, taken in the environment the gate uses, and 118 errors of real repair under it.

1043 was banked as 1049 -> 1043, a delta applied to a number nobody re-measured;
its own note said so. Measured at 4406b0ebf2e, the commit that set it, this job
would have counted 1114 -- wrong by 71 the day it was written, so py_typecheck.yml
has failed on every run since. An exact ratchet that cannot pass protects nothing,
because the only way to read it is to ignore it: that is how 52 further errors
reached files py_scope_gate had locked as CLEAN without anyone being told. The
workflow header already records this happening once (a floor of 1379, "a count no
environment produces"); this replaces the number with a measurement instead.

  floor said        1043    derived, never measured
  at 4406b0ebf2e    1114    what this job would have counted that day
  at 5fd8013596c    1119    HEAD before this work
  banked            1001    and py_scope_gate is at 0 FAIL

THE LARGEST SINGLE CAUSE WAS A BASE CLASS THAT UNDER-DECLARED ITSELF.

BaseCursor -- what Environment.cr is typed as, so what nearly everything holds --
declared `execute` and `dictfetchone` and not `fetchall`, while `fetchscalar` on
that same class calls `self.fetchone()`. Every concrete cursor provides the family:
Cursor and InMemoryCursor implement it, TestCursor forwards it through __getattr__.
13 call sites read rows off a BaseCursor and each was an error. Adding `fetchall`
and `rowcount` to the TYPE_CHECKING block that already held `close` and `fetchone`
-- type-only, so TestCursor keeps forwarding -- cleared 78 of the 118 on its own,
and let db/schema.py stop asking 29 of its 31 introspection helpers for a whole
Cursor when BaseCursor is what every caller has. InMemoryCursor gained the
`rowcount` the other two already answer.

The rest, by cause:

  an optional indexed where the caller already knew it was not None, and a
  savepoint that RESTORES orm state without the `txn is None` guard its own
  _save_orm_state has -- a latent AttributeError, not only a type error

  members a mixin calls on its siblings, declared in _ModelStubs where that
  problem is already solved, and members a test double stands in for, declared
  as Protocols beside db.savepoint.SavepointHost, which has always done this

  attributes a setUpClass invents, accumulators with no annotation, and a
  handful of deliberate contract violations that are the POINT of their tests
  and now say so with a scoped ignore

py_scope_gate: 26 FAIL -> 0, with its lists re-derived. Every budget it rewrote
went DOWN and one file moved from the exception list into the locked set; nothing
was added to the exceptions.

Reproduced with the workflow`s own recipe: mypy 2.3.0 alone in a fresh venv,
detached worktree, --no-incremental, grep -cE ": error:".
